name: 40K Robotic Grasp Demonstrations
summary: 包含约四万条自然场景六自由度机器人抓取示范的数据集，记录视觉观测、末端位姿和抓取结果，用于学习从视觉到动作的操作策略。
summaryEn: A dataset of roughly 40,000 naturalistic 6-DoF robotic grasp demonstrations with visual observations, end-effector poses, and grasp outcomes for visuomotor learning.
scaleZh: 约 4 万条抓取示范 · 六自由度末端执行器动作
organizationsZh: 华盛顿大学及合作团队
license: Project-specific terms; verify data access and downstream use
licenseZh: 适用项目专用条款；需核查数据访问和下游使用限制
wmNote: 视觉、末端动作和抓取结果构成动作条件轨迹，适合操作模型预训练；任务主要集中在抓取。
wmNoteEn: Visual observations, end-effector actions, and outcomes form action-conditioned trajectories, while task diversity is centered on grasping.
